scope: Integrated enlarged browser review of the final complexion, studio light, fixed contour, dental assembly, tongue placement and combined-pose facial normals. This report covers neutral, surprise and laughter from front, profile and three-quarter views; all eight expressions and FORM are checked in their separate edition records.

capture.scope: Actual app at 1.7x camera zoom, 1.5 devicePixelRatio; UI text hidden for close anatomical inspection only

baseline: The before-* captures route only the preserved prior runtime modules from archive/skinned-v5-before-complexion. Candidate and integrated-* captures are intermediate iterations, not the final review.
reviewedViews: surprise at 2.5 seconds: front, profile, three-quarter
laughter at 2.5 seconds: front, profile, three-quarter
observations: Face and neck now have a continuous warm complexion without the broad gray/brown patches that read as stubble in the previous version. Fine residual detail remains intentionally subdued.
Softer brow transition, narrower nasal base and restrained cheek fullness complement the existing tapered jaw and rounded chin. The profile retains chin projection and lip volume.

Upper incisors are visible at the upper lip instead of leaving the opening dominated by lower crowns and a bright tongue. The smile has individually separated rounded crowns and a darker mouth interior.
The recessed tongue no longer forms a flat red plate across surprise. Both dental arches retain their original attachment and expression targets.
The combined-pose normal correction removes the strong false triangular highlight at the smiling mouth corner without reducing the laughter pose.
Studio fill maintains soft cheek and neck transitions, while nostril, lid and lip structure remain readable.
limits: This remains a stylized realtime licensed asset, not a photographic digital double; the unchanged textured hair and eyelashes remain apparent at enlarged inspection scale.
A small bright detail at the far clavicle silhouette is present in both archived and current three-quarter captures and is not claimed repaired.
Posterior teeth remain more exposed in oblique surprise views than from the front. Mouth darkening is an artistic shading approximation rather than traced oral light transport.
Still captures establish only the views actually listed. Deterministic timing, active playback, mobile and selection are recorded separately.
